minimal_ptobench_collection_request.reason: The current combined collector and all 16 archived Profiles provide aggregate MTE PMU counters and ordinary runtime intervals, but no paired runtime Compute/MTE stage intervals that can be joined for overlap.

event_definition.interval: Each record must provide a device-local monotonic start and end timestamp for one Compute or MTE stage event; intervals are interpreted as half-open [start, end), with end greater than start.
event_definition.overlap_definition: Within identical Candidate, Profile event, device/rank, dispatch, and task-or-block identity, overlap duration is max(0, min(compute.end, mte.end) - max(compute.start, mte.start)); retain source intervals and report unmatched or invalid records separately.

identity_requirements: Candidate SHA-256 and PTOBench Profile event ID
Dispatch identifier and task or block correlation key shared by Compute and MTE events
Collection-window identifier and event/source record identifier
clock_and_unit_requirements: Compute and MTE intervals for a given device must use the same monotonic clock domain, timestamp unit, resolution, and clock anchor.

If timestamps are cycles, provide the clock frequency or a validated conversion to a common duration unit; do not compare raw cycles from different devices without a validated cross-device synchronization mapping.
Document timestamp wrap/reset behavior and clock-correlation error bounds for every compared interval set.

target_case.rationale: Use this existing representative prefill Case as the first post-collector-schema validation because its two-rank archive exercises device/rank identity joins while reusing a known Candidate and Profile path. This is a validation target, not a claim that overlap currently exists.
target_case.gate: Do not run it until the collector demonstrably emits the required event schema; reuse the existing Profile only if Candidate, device, software, configuration, and collection window all match and the new fields are present.

independent_acceptance_checks: A separate raw-artifact validator confirms all required identity and clock fields, valid positive-length intervals, and source record counts without calling PTOAnalyzer diagnostics.
Compute and MTE records join only on exact Candidate/Profile/device/rank/dispatch/task-or-block/window keys; report join coverage and unmatched records.

A fixture with known overlapping, disjoint, boundary-touching, mismatched-identity, and invalid-clock intervals produces independently hand-calculated overlap durations and preserves missing-data distinctions.
On the selected Case, independently recompute each joined overlap interval and aggregate from raw records; PTOAnalyzer output must match exactly, with per-rank coverage and archive hashes unchanged.
